subject: english
title: Noun Stadium — Person, Place, Thing, Idea
subtitle: Walk the 8 stations of the noun stadium: the 4 doors, the noun-spotting tricks, common vs proper, the plural machines, countable vs uncountable, possessive 's, compound nouns, and the a/an/the gate. 34 slides, 11 drills.

content: Define a noun as the name of a person, place, thing, or idea, and sort words into those four doors.
Spot nouns inside a sentence using four tests: the a/the test, the counting test, the position test, and the Japanese 名前 bridge.
Distinguish common nouns from proper nouns and explain why proper nouns take a capital letter.
language: Form regular plurals with the four plural machines (-s, -es, consonant + y → -ies, -f/-fe → -ves) and produce the common irregular plurals.
Separate countable from uncountable nouns, including the traps homework and information, and choose the right form after how much / how many.
Use possessive 's correctly and tell it apart from the contraction of is, build compound nouns, and choose between a, an, and the.
